prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: PRODUCTION game sprite sheet, not a concept poster. Input image is the approved ASC UA hero identity reference: preserve this exact copper orange crooked pointed cap with crossed stitches, cheeky adult duende face, freckles and long sideways pointed ears, brown tousled hair, petrol blue cropped jacket, orange neck scarf, ochre shirt, dark brown cropped trousers, worn brown boots and small acorn satchel. Warm detailed pixel art for a fixed top-down three-quarter RPG camera, clearly defined color clusters, readable face and boots at 80px final height. Do not make a different costume or another character. Camera angle looking down around 35 degrees; show crown of hat and tops of boots. Sprites are not viewed straight-on at eye level. Exact sheet layout: EIGHT COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS = 32 equal cells, landscape 2048x1024. One full figure centered in every cell, no overlapping cells. All figures share exactly the same body scale. Each row is an animation pose; each COLUMN is one direction, in this exact order LEFT TO RIGHT: SOUTH facing viewer, SOUTH-EAST front and facing lower-right, EAST right side profile, NORTH-EAST back facing upper-right, NORTH fully back no face, NORTH-WEST back facing upper-left, WEST left side profile, SOUTH-WEST front facing lower-left. Eight genuinely different camera-facing directions, NOT all front views. Each cell is 256 square. Feet contact anchor x128 y235 in each cell. Standing figure from hat tip y22 to feet y235, with both ears and hands within its own cell. Whole-body silhouette fully visible. No grid lines, labels, numbers, arrows, text, floor or cast shadow. Genuinely transparent alpha background preferred; if unavailable use exactly flat pure #FF00FF magenta matte, no gradient or glow. Never paint magenta on the character. Action rows TOP TO BOTTOM: ROW1 relaxed neutral idle arms down and mischievous smile. ROW2 walking CONTACT with left leg forward and right arm forward, opposing leg back. ROW3 passing step with one foot under body and other heel lifting. ROW4 opposite CONTACT with right leg forward and left arm forward, opposing leg back. Strong readable heel/toe steps in the direction each column faces, knees and arms genuinely articulated, not shifting the whole same body. Maintain stable body proportions and same foot registration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original warm pixel-art game currency asset sheet. Exactly four isolated views of THE SAME coin in a 2 by 2 grid, 1024x1024 square, generous blank gutters and no labels. A small coin handmade from a THIN ROUND CROSS-SECTION OF A TREE BRANCH with visible natural wood grain on the side, a hand-painted metallic GOLDEN RIM, RICH WARM RED circular front face and a clearly legible SIMPLE WHITE MUSHROOM painted at its center. The mushroom is white, not a red mushroom on white. No letters or numbers or heraldry. Upper left: fully front-facing coin for inventory icon; upper right: shallow tilted three-quarter view showing golden rim and wood thickness; lower left: more edge-on tilted view for a tossing animation; lower right: nearly horizontal coin viewed top-down at 35degrees for resting at the bottom of a fountain, clearly still red white and gold. Same coin, original charming forest-craft feeling, irregular natural wood rim, crisp clean pixel clusters and readable silhouette at 24 pixels, NOT a photoreal coin or blurred illustration. All four coins centered within their cells, no hands, no shadow, no water, no background scene. Transparent background with true alpha; if alpha unavailable exactly solid #FF00FF magenta matte, never a gradient. This coin belongs to a playful woodland duende game.
